clips.title: The story
paras: In Orgrimmar, Gan'rul Bloodeye sends warlocks south to Ratchet for deeper training. There, a human summoner teaches arts beyond the reach of basic summoning.

Gan'rul Bloodeye trains young warlocks in the Cleft of Shadow, where they learn to command the Nether. When an apprentice outgrows that teaching, Gan'rul points them beyond the city walls. More volatile beings call for instruction from someone with deeper mastery of dark arcana.

Gan'rul sends apprentices to Strahad Farsan, a human sorcerer in a tower above Ratchet's goblin port. Horde and humans may be enemies, but warlocks look beyond ordinary faction loyalties. Power, discipline, and ritual knowledge matter more than ancestry. Strahad judges an apprentice by their inner hatred and ability to subjugate, not their skin color.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I have taught you skills in the past, but the time has come for another to teach you. He is in Ratchet, and his name is Strahad. He is human, but do not let that fool you into thinking he is weak. He is powerful even though he may be small. He can teach you about more powerful summonings—I feel you are ready. Go to him now. He is in Ratchet... Above the port town next to his tower.

clips.title: Completion
paras: A busy day in Ratchet, isn't it? How I enjoy watching the toil of a port city. So much mystery, so much adventure... So much ignorance.
Is that hatred I see in your eyes, friend? Good, we will put that to good use.
